options.name: numbers below n: crossed out (grey), known primes (green)

bind.visited: [k for k in range(2, n) if not is_prime[k]] if 'is_prime' in locals() else []
bind.found: [k for k in range(2, n) if is_prime[k] and (__line__ == 10 or ('p' in locals() and k <= p and (k < p or __line__ in (6, 8))))] if 'is_prime' in locals() else []
bind.pointers: {'p': p} if 'p' in locals() and p < n and __line__ != 10 else {}
